description: v6.34 independently reviewed compact worker interface. All 65 active rules at rule version 63 remain verbatim with scopes, checks and exceptions. The five original CORE standards are unchanged. Worker-standard retains content organization and exact manual Word parameters; repeated rule explanations route to the original applicable sections. Full formula correctness, unique formula identity, complete symbol explanation, source-preserving corrections, wording/antecedent rules, figure scope and caption/flow requirements remain binding. Draft evidence is not independent acceptance; stages, six checks, complete current-page coverage, verified-scope inheritance and immediate delivery remain unchanged. The math/figure index routes to complete frozen originals without loading irrelevant formula details for figure-only cases. Source changes require a new coverage review before updating hashes.
